Affordable Housing for Rent in New York City

Studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom rentals available through the affordable housing program for qualifying future residents at AVA High Line.

40% PROGRAM

STUDIO: $1,038 PER MONTH**
1 person household $45,360

Households must be under the income levels below to qualify. The monthly rent is based on the Area Median Income (AMI).

50% PROGRAM

STUDIO: $1,321 PER MONTH*
1 person household $56,700
ONE-BEDROOM: $1,409 PER MONTH*
1 person household $56,700
2 person household $64,800

Households must be under the income levels below to qualify. The monthly rent is based on the Area Median Income (AMI).

60% PROGRAM

STUDIO: $1,605 PER MONTH*
1 person household $68,040
ONE-BEDROOM: $1,713 PER MONTH*
1 person household $68,040
2 person household $77,760
TWO-BEDROOM: $2,043 PER MONTH*
2 person household $77,760
3 person household $87,480
4 person household $97,200

Households must be under the income levels below to qualify. The monthly rent is based on the Area Median Income (AMI).

AVA High Line residents are responsible for electric, phone, and cable utilities. Additional monthly fees ma apply for parking and pets. An increased security deposit will be required for households with pets.

Minimum income rate does not apply for households applying with a housing voucher.

*Rents subject to change anytime without notice.
